## Decision Recorded
**Timestamp**: 2026-11-10T15:24:41Z

**Stage**: functional-design
**Decision**: Q1 what starts and measures the 30-day deletion window; Q2 legal hold before BRD-017; Q3 how erasure runs; Q4 what a pending-deletion account can do
**Options**: Q1: A exactly 720 hours from the request, B 30 calendar days at midnight UTC; Q2: A unconditional erasure until the register exists, B a manual hold flag on the user; Q3: A a scheduled job processes due deletions, B synchronous on the transition; Q4: A read-only, no new data, B full use until the window ends
